name: EDTeKLA Development Corpus v1
description: Full EDTeKLA textbook dev corpus: 436 entries across difficulty tiers 1-5 (from 486 total: 436 dev + 50 held-out test).
quarantineReason: EdTeKLA's corpora carry a modified, sovereignty-scoped CC BY-NC-SA (LicenseRef-EdTeKLA-Modified-CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0; non-commercial; corpus content not hosted or redistributed by Champollion). Per the crk-incident dataset doctrine, EdTeKLA-derived crk assets are carved out of every prize/API/commercial lane and must never rank. Quarantined as defense-in-depth so no run can be published or ranked against it.

source.ref_note: Pinned to the upstream master HEAD verified on 2026-06-11; a rebuild at this commit reproduces the published dev corpus byte-for-byte.

license.notes: Not plain CC BY-NC-SA: EdTeKLA's repo README modifies the license to maintain the sovereignty and control of the content creators — materials designated for community/academic/educational uses, sharing scoped to educational purposes in classrooms and communities, the original speaker retains rights, and per-corpus restrictions may apply (verified 2026-07-19, github.com/EdTeKLA/IndigenousLanguages_Corpora README). License chain: the root work 'Cree: Language of the Plains' (Okimāsis, U of R Press open textbook) is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Champollion rebuilds locally from upstream at a pinned ref and never hosts or redistributes the content; transmission to model APIs only over no-train channels (docs/DATA_BOUNDARIES.md §Transmission to model APIs).

quality.translatorQualifications: L1 Plains Cree speakers, certified educators

contamination.reasoning: The source data is public on GitHub (EdTeKLA/IndigenousLanguages_Corpora), so it may appear in web-crawl-derived LLM training data. No direct evidence of inclusion in a specific model's training set. The earlier 'NONE / private corpus' rating was incorrect and was corrected on 2026-06-11.
